method: Chromium native touch, hybrid iPad-like UA, same-thread HTML canvas PNG plus a diagnostic OffscreenCanvas convertToBlob request. Times are relative to pointerdown.
findings: Both the real HTML PNG callback and the diagnostic OffscreenCanvas callback were deferred to about112.9ms after contact.

A later FileReader operation within the same gesture was deferred by about97.1ms.
A simple same-thread swap to OffscreenCanvas convertToBlob did not remove this local deferral; that alternative is ruled out for this tested path, not every engine or worker architecture.
